one_line: Open on the messy end state with a "you won't believe" line, then show the process and the child's payoff.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl about 8 to 10 looks into the lens, squeezing a multi-coloured slime lump, handheld. Subtitled from the first frame and said (transcript): "לא תאמינו מה זה היה לפני דקה". The word "תאמינו" is highlighted.
q1_hook.why: A messy, colourful close-up plus "what was this a minute ago" poses a concrete question the Reel answers at 0:38 (H5, H1). A face looking at the lens with a voice and subtitle at once suits sound on and off (H4, H6). The kit box appears only at 0:03 (S1).

beats.what: Girl squeezes a colourful slime lump at the lens; "לא תאמינו מה זה היה לפני דקה"
beats.why: Shows an end state and asks how it got there

beats.what: Kit box tilted to show its pictured cake; "מאז שחזרנו לשגרת הלימודים"
beats.why: Names the product and the context

beats.what: Open kit on a table: instruction sheet, boxes, tools; "ללא מסכים"
beats.why: States the need: a screen-free afternoon

beats.what: Girl kneads yellow slime, opens sachet number 1; "הפעם הבאתי לה סליימי"
beats.why: Starts the making with a named product

beats.what: Hands press yellow slime into a pink mould, building layers
beats.why: Effort is visible; the voice adds "ואז כמובן הרסה"

beats.what: Teal slime frosting covers the cake; "ורק אז המשחק התחיל באמת"
beats.why: The voice spoils the smash, so viewers wait for it

beats.what: Sprinkles, then white slime cream piped with a syringe tool
beats.why: Decorating adds colour and the finishing touch

beats.what: Girl smiles and holds the finished cake to the lens
beats.why: The proud result, at the emotional peak

beats.what: She squashes the cake with both hands into a lump

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption's first line is a question ("אחר הצהריים עם גדולים ללא מסכים? לגמרי אפשרי") but asks nothing of the viewer.
q2_flow.why: The opening promises a surprise that lands at 0:38 to 0:44, and the voice mentions the smash at 0:22 so viewers keep waiting (H5, K2). A new action every 1 to 3 s moves the middle (R3, E2). The layering and kneading stretch is the slowest part (R3). The last shot echoes the first (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. None in the caption: it ends with a thanks line tagging @palphot and 5 hashtags. The voice ends on a benefit (screen-free, no need to leave home), not an ask.
q3_cta.why: No ask means a viewer who wants the kit has no next step except the retailer's name (C6). It stays clean of bait (C2, C1), but a relatable afternoon idea could earn a send with one named reason, and a specific question could earn comments (C4, C5).

q4_shown.what: The slime at 0:00, the box and its pictured cake at 0:03, the open kit at 0:06, then each making step in close-up; the finished cake held to the lens at 0:38, squashed at 0:40. A girl about 8 to 10. No price.
q4_shown.why: The whole process is shown in use, so a parent can picture it at home (S1, F8), with a proud smile at the peak (K8) and a parent's own voice vouching (S6). The girl's face, her name in the caption and a round logo on her shirt are what LumeBook's Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 28 shots in 44 s (first pass count), about 1.6 s each, hard cuts that land on voice phrases, handheld angle changes. No speed changes. Subtitles in 2 to 4 word chunks, one word highlighted. Ends on the squashing, no end card.
q5_edit.why: A new picture for each phrase keeps a quick, readable pace (E2, R3). Subtitles with one highlighted word give rhythm and work muted (E4, T1) but repeat every word (T2). The Reel stops right after the payoff, with no tail (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A screen-free afternoon activity: a child builds a slime cake, then squashes it. It serves parents looking for something to do at home after school.
q6_topic.why: Filling afternoons without screens is a live parent concern (K6), and the first-person voice sounds like a parent sharing. Building a cake just to destroy it is a recognisable child moment (K3) that ends in delight (K1). It is not a gift moment (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone, upright, at a dining table in room light. Selfie-distance medium shot of the girl at start and end; top-down and side close-ups of hands and box between. A TV is on behind at 0:07 to 0:11 and 0:32.
q7_filmed.why: Home, phone and a real child give a native, unpolished look (H8, F7), and the hands-on close-ups fill the frame (F4, F5). She looks into the lens at the start and the end (F6). A TV on in the background sits against the voice saying "ללא מסכים" (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White Hebrew subtitles in 2 to 4 word chunks, one word per chunk in a coloured highlight box, about 85% down the frame over the hands: 0:00 "לא תאמינו מה זה", 0:01 "היה לפני דקה", 0:08 "ללא מסכים לא בכל", 0:25 "אותה לעיסת סליים", 0:36 "ללא מסכים ובלי צורך". No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "אחר הצהריים עם גדולים ללא מסכים? לגמרי אפשרי 🤍". About 43 words: a line naming the child who made the cake, a benefit line, a thanks line "בשיתו׳ף @palphot האדירים", 5 hashtags. No CTA.
q8_text.why: The first subtitle states the surprise at once, and the highlight makes it scannable (T3, T1), but the lower band sits under the Reels buttons (T4, F2). The caption uses searchable words, 5 specific hashtags and a hook-like first line (T7). The partnership is named in words but near the end (T8, S7).

weak_points: No CTA or question; a TV on in the background against "ללא מסכים"; the child's face, name in the caption and a logo on her shirt; subtitles in the bottom band; disclosure near the end of the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a striking spread with a "you won't believe" line, then show unboxing and page flips with hands only, and end back on that spread.
not_verified: Who says the first line (the girl's lips move at 0:01 to 0:02, audio cannot be heard); whether the first 2 s come from the end of the same take; music; what the round logo on her shirt is; whether the disclosure shows above "more". Correction to src/coded: face_on_camera is the girl, no adult face is seen. Cut count from the first pass.
